0022600123.text: The Indiana Pacers (1-1, on a one-game losing streak) visit the Milwaukee Bucks (0-3, on a three-game losing streak), with the Pacers 3rd in the Central, 1 game back, and 9th in the East, while the Bucks are 5th in the Central, 2.5 games back, and 14th in the East. The Pacers are missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), all listed as out. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Pacers lost all four meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently 134-123 in Milwaukee on March 15, 2026.
